_readme: Sharing a story to WhatsApp status (Avraham, 2026-10-19). For each story listed here, its 'share' button (on the site's card and on the story page s/<slug>/, en/s/<slug>/) asks: as a message (as before) or to status. 'hook' is printed on the status picture (line 1 dark, line 2 teal), made by tools/build_status_images.py into assets/images/status/<slug>.jpg (Hebrew) and assets/images/status/en/<slug>.jpg (English). 'caption' is the text that goes with it ({url} = the story's listening page). 'pill' (optional) = the label at the bottom of the picture, for a recording that is not a story. 'popup': true = when the story ends on its page, a popup invites the listener to share it to status. Avraham, 2026-10-19: the text must not say the listening is free. After a change: python tools/build_status_images.py, then node tools/build_story_pages.mjs.
